embed_call_per_query.label: one embed call per unique query, measured on this machine, not a guarantee

latency_ms.label: measurement on this machine, not a guarantee

limitations: REAL CORPUS IS THE MEASUREMENT CEILING: both real documents fit in a single chunk each, so any top-k>=2 retrieval over the real section trivially includes the gold chunk whenever the query embeds anywhere near the corpus — real-corpus metrics cannot discriminate retrieval quality (spec hypothesis H10).
The eval collection holds 8 chunks total (2 real + fixture chunks); synthetic-fixture metrics show discriminating behavior but DO NOT establish real-world retrieval accuracy.
Answer-level metrics (citation correctness, unsupported-claim rate) are NOT measured: they require chat-model calls, which are outside this authorization.
The abstention proxy measures only the deterministic score floor; production refusal also involves prompt and grounding behavior that requires a chat model.

gap_list: No real multi-column documents in the corpus (only the synthetic columns fixture).
No real scanned/image-only pages in the corpus (only the synthetic scan fixture).
No real tables in the corpus (only the synthetic table fixtures).
No real multi-page tables, figures, charts, or captions in the corpus.
No Arabic-language cases (Q4=A: English-only initial baseline).
No genuine real-corpus cross-document questions beyond the single crafted comparison R011.
No footnotes/references sections in the corpus.
No documents larger than one 1024-token chunk: every corpus file and fixture fits in a single chunk under current chunking, so chunk-boundary behavior is NOT exercised by this gold set.
Answer-level metrics (citation correctness, unsupported-claim rate) are out of RAG-1 scope: they require chat-model calls, which are not authorized.

failures_and_timeouts.note: a written baseline implies zero failures on this run: an embed/Ollama failure aborts BEFORE indexing with exit 2 and no baseline; an ingest failure aborts with exit 1; a retrieval error raises out and no baseline is written. Counts are of THIS run, not of the pipeline under all conditions.
